# External-link icons

The colored social icons and Wikidata mark are hosted locally so the interface does not depend on a third-party image or font service.

- `x.svg`, `facebook.svg`, `instagram.svg`, `linkedin.svg`, `mastodon.svg`, `youtube.svg`: [Govdirectory's SVG assets](https://github.com/govdirectory/website/tree/main/static/social-icons).
- `wikidata.svg`: [Govdirectory's Wikidata mark](https://github.com/govdirectory/website/blob/main/static/wikidata.svg).
- `bluesky.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/bluesky.svg), with a blue fill added to the SVG.

Source license texts are included alongside the assets. Brand marks remain the trademarks of their respective owners. Generic website and Wikipedia icons use the project's existing Material Symbols font and Wikipedia SVG path, respectively.

- `tiktok.svg`, `rumble.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/develop/icons), with local brand-color fills. Covered by the included Simple Icons license.
- `truthsocial.svg`: SVG recreation of the geometric mark in [Truth Social's published app icon](https://truthsocial.com/icons/icon-512x512.png), linked by the platform's own homepage. This is a platform brand mark, not Simple Icons artwork; no separate artwork license was supplied by the source. Trademark ownership remains with Truth Social.

- `threads.svg`, `substack.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/develop/icons), with local brand-color fills; covered by the included Simple Icons license.
